components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Fluent-blue action button — the accent's main job.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; background: var(--accent, #0078d4); color: #ffffff; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; transition: background-color 150ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover, #106ebe); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(0,120,212,0.4); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Bordered neutral button for non-primary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; background: var(--bg-surface, #ffffff); color: var(--text-primary, #161616); font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, #e5e5e8); border-radius: 8px; transition: background-color 150ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--bg-sunken, #f0f0f2); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(0,120,212,0.4); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Mono status pill — 15% tint + saturated text of the same hue.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; white-space: nowrap; border-radius: 999px; font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-weight: 500; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: -0.01em; padding: 2px 8px; } .ds-badge-neutral { background: var(--bg-sunken, #f0f0f2); color: var(--text-secondary, #555559); } .ds-badge-warning { background: rgba(245,158,11,0.15); color: var(--warning, #f59e0b); }

components.name: Input
components.description: Hairline-bordered field; focus = strong border + green ring.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 40px; width: 100%; max-width: 280px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, #e5e5e8); background: var(--bg-canvas, #ffffff); padding: 0 12px; font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-primary, #161616); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-muted, #8b8b90); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--border-strong, #d2d2d6); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(0,120,212,0.3); }

narrative.overview: NoPM looks like the tool of an engineer who runs a tight ship: a white, light-first macOS workspace with a dark terminal beating at its center. The operating surfaces are calm, dense, and typographically quiet — near-black ink on white, one rationed blue accent — while the terminal motif carries the brand's proof moments. Restraint is the personality: color means status, never decoration; monospace means data, never costume.
keyCharacteristics: Light-first white canvas with a component-scoped fixed-dark terminal surface (#0e0e0f) in BOTH themes
One brand accent (Fluent blue #0078d4); status hues never leak into branding
SF/Inter for prose, SF Mono/JetBrains Mono for anything technical
Hairline borders do the separating; shadows are reserved for overlays
Density tuned for operators: 14px body, tight tables, generous section separation

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Fluent blue is the only color allowed to mean 'NoPM.' Status hues appear only on the state they name, in tint-plus-saturated-text pills, never as fills or decoration.

rules.name: The Mono-Means-Data Rule
rules.body: Monospace is reserved for code, commands, identifiers, scopes, and measured values. Prose never sets in mono; data never sets in prose type.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces at rest are flat and bordered. Shadow is a statement of layering, never decoration.

dos: Do use semantic tokens — every color in the system has a token
Do give every status pill the tint+text treatment, which survives both themes
Do keep the terminal surface #0e0e0f fixed in both themes — the terminal being dark IS the brand
Do set anything machine-ish (IDs, scopes, counts, commands, timestamps) in mono
Do verify dark mode for every new surface
donts: Don't introduce gradients, glass/blur decoration, or colored border-left accents
Don't use the brand blue for status or any status hue for branding
Don't hardcode Tailwind palette classes — they broke dark mode once already
Don't add resting shadows to cards or emoji as icons
Don't exceed the three-step ink hierarchy for text
